gate_results.rationale: Selected vendor CedarPoint Digital 85431-2 has sanctions screening "pending" (PROC-SAN-002, SUSPENSION) and third-party due diligence "pending" (PROC-DD-001, REWORK). Mandatory criteria failed = 0, so no PROC-MAND-001; TCO 535,507 EUR is well under the 7,000,000 EUR envelope (no PROC-BUDGET-001); references_checked = true (no PROC-REF-001). Highest-priority triggered disposition is SUSPENSION, which requires authorization.

Applying the legal decision rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot: personal_data=true but dpa_status=\"signed\" (no LEGAL-DPA-001); liability_cap_multiplier=2 with security_carveout=true (no LEGAL-LIAB-001); audit_right=\"full\" (no LEGAL-AUDIT-001); exit_assistance_days=180 (no LEGAL-EXIT-001); insurance_valid=true (no LEGAL-INS-001); signing_authority_valid=true (no LEGAL-SIGN-001); log_export_clause=\"limited\" not \"missing\" (no LEGAL-LOG-001). The only triggered finding is LEGAL-IP-001 because ip_ownership=\"ambiguous\", which maps to disposition REWORK with action CLARIFY_IP_OWNERSHIP and risk_acceptance_allowed=False. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required. MSA clause 8 corroborates the ambiguous IP position.

Applying the compliance decision rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot: dpia_required=true but dpia_status=\"complete\" (no COMP-DPIA-001); audit_trail=\"complete\" (no COMP-AUDIT-001); regulatory_mapping=\"partial\" not \"missing\" (no COMP-MAP-001); accessibility_status=\"pass\" (no COMP-A11Y-001). Two findings trigger: residency_compliant=false with required_residency=\"EU\" while actual region is \"UAE North\" (COMP-RESID-001, critical, NO_GO, action RELOCATE_DATA_OR_OBTAIN_VALID_BASIS), corroborated by DATA_INVENTORY (actual_region \"UAE North\", required_residency \"EU\"); and export_control=\"pending\" (COMP-EXPORT-002, high, SUSPENSION, action COMPLETE_EXPORT_CONTROL_REVIEW). Highest-priority triggered disposition is NO_GO, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization is required. Neither finding permits risk acceptance, so the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) does not cover them.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 security rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (phase=design). SEC-WAF-001 (critical, NO_GO) triggers: the workload is internet-facing ("internet_exposed": true) with no WAF control ("waf_present": false, "waf_mode": "None"), corroborated by authoritative WAF_POLICY {"present": false, "mode": "None"}. SEC-IAM-001 (high, REWORK) triggers: MFA is not mandatory ("mfa": "missing" != "mandatory"), corroborated by CONDITIONAL_ACCESS {"mfa": "missing", ... "policy_state": "reportOnly"}. No other candidate finding triggers: SEC-WAF-002 requires waf_present=true; SEC-NET-001 is satisfied because data_classification "Restricted" is paired with "private_endpoints": true (AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH confirms "private_endpoints": true); SEC-IAM-002 ("shared_service_principal": false), SEC-LOG-001 ("logs_to_siem": true), SEC-VULN-001 ("critical_vulns_open": 0), SEC-KEY-001 ("key_rotation_days": 30) and SEC-PENTEST-001 (phase is design, not build_acceptance) are all untriggered. Highest-priority triggered disposition is NO_GO, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization is required. The standing mandate MANDATE-c0eebffe-87e5-582a-88a2-ab0eeaa573ea-BUY-04-SECURITY-1 covers only risk-acceptable findings, and both triggered findings have risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so no conditional approval is available; remediation actions (IMPLEMENT_WAF, ENFORCE_MFA) are proposed, not completed. Upstream design-phase decisions (procurement SUSPENSION, legal REWORK, compliance NO_GO) do not alter this gate's finding set.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 IT rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot (phase=build_acceptance), no candidate finding triggers. IT-CATALOG-001 requires catalog_status='non_standard' AND waiver_present false; observed "catalog_status": "standard" and "waiver_present": true (corroborated by authoritative TECH_CATALOG {"catalog_status": "standard", "waiver_present": true, "waiver_expiry_days": 180}). IT-RATIONAL-001 requires duplicate_capability=true; observed "duplicate_capability": false. IT-LICENSE-001 requires license_compliant=false; observed "license_compliant": true ("annual_license_cost_eur": 39978). IT-CMDB-001 requires cmdb_record_present=false; observed "cmdb_record_present": true (SUPPORT_RACI also records "CMDB required | Yes"). IT-RUN-001 requires run_owner_present=false; observed "run_owner_present": true (SUPPORT_RACI: "Run owner | Elena Nguyen-12001-SO"). IT-EOL-001 requires technology_eol_months<12; observed "technology_eol_months": 60 (LIFECYCLE_REGISTER eol_months=60). IT-CAPACITY-001 requires capacity_headroom_pct<15; observed "capacity_headroom_pct": 45 (LIFECYCLE_REGISTER capacity_headroom_pct=45). IT-CHANGE-001 requires change_record_status in ('draft','missing') AND phase=='deployment_closure'; "change_record_status": "missing" is observed, but the current phase is build_acceptance, so the phase predicate is not satisfied and the finding does not apply. With zero triggered findings the disposition is GO, and GO is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required. Upstream design-phase decisions (procurement SUSPENSION, legal REWORK, compliance NO_GO, security NO_GO) are prior-phase specialist decisions and do not alter this gate's finding set.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 general rule to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL snapshot (phase=governance): strategic_alignment=\"strong\" so GEN-STRAT-001 does not trigger. GEN-BUDGET-001 triggers because budget_requested_eur=7000000 exceeds budget_approved_eur=4900000, corroborated by authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL (requested_eur 7000000, approved_eur 4900000, status PARTIAL) — action OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL, disposition SUSPENSION. roi=0.114 >= 0.05 so GEN-BC-001 does not trigger. Two upstream gates returned NO_GO (compliance BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 and security BUY-04-SECURITY-1), so GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO triggers (critical, NO_GO, action RESOLVE_UPSTREAM_NO_GO). Phase is governance, not deployment_closure, so GEN-BENEFITS-001 does not apply. Highest-priority triggered disposition is NO_GO, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization is required. Neither triggered finding permits risk acceptance, so the standing mandate (scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) does not cover them; proposed remediation actions are not completed remediation.
